description: A liquid navigation bar: the active item sits in a solid pill, and a gap opens around whichever item you hover or select while the two pills bend into a curved neck, so the bar reads as a single drop of liquid being stretched.
interactionNotes: Hovering or selecting an item opens a gap around it and the neighbouring pills reach towards each other with a curved neck. The gaps are spring driven, so they overshoot a little and settle back. Every item is a real link: a click calls `onSelect` and, by default, prevents the browser from following `href`. Tab reaches each item and shows a focus outline. With `prefers-reduced-motion`, the gaps jump straight to their place instead of springing.

props.items: The links. Each item has a `label`, a `link` and an optional fixed `width`; without a width the pill measures the rendered label plus `paddingX`.
props.defaultActiveIndex: Which item starts selected when the bar keeps its own state.
props.activeIndex: Controlled selection; pass it with `onSelect` to own the state yourself.
props.onSelect: Runs on every click with the index and the item.
props.pillColor: Fill of the pills and of the liquid neck between them.
props.textColor: Label color, and the color of the active dot.
props.hoverTextColor: Label color of the item under the pointer.
props.fontSize: Label size, pixels; the pill height follows it together with `paddingY`.
props.paddingX: Horizontal padding inside each pill; it is part of the measured width.
props.paddingY: Vertical padding; the pill height is `fontSize` plus twice this.
props.cornerRadius: Corner radius of the pills, clamped to half the pill height.
props.gap: Space between the pills at rest.
props.neighborPush: How far the gap opens around the hovered or active item, pixels.
props.anchorEdge: Which edge stays put while the gaps push the bar wider. It is logical, so `start` means the right edge in a right-to-left page.
props.neckRatio: Thickness of the liquid neck as a fraction of the pill height.
props.stiffness: Spring stiffness of the gaps; higher snaps faster.
props.damping: Spring damping; lower lets the gaps overshoot more.
props.className: Extra class for the root box.

tips: Keep the labels short: each pill measures the rendered label plus `paddingX`, so a very long one makes a very wide pill.
The labels are measured again once the web font finishes loading, which keeps the pills aligned when the project uses a custom Persian font.
Use `start` and `end` for `anchorEdge`, not left and right: the geometry is mirrored for right-to-left, so `start` pins the bar to the right edge.
Pass `activeIndex` with `onSelect` to control the selection; without them the bar remembers the last click itself.
Clicks call `preventDefault()`, so handle the destination in `onSelect` or swap the anchor for your router's link.
Hover needs a real pointer; on touch the pill and its dot still mark the active item, but the liquid neck stays away.
